decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy builds directly on the firm's existing psychiatric and mental health expertise, so the firm can readily interpret results and improve it, and its move to the home page signals growing commitment.
Senior living counseling draws on the firm's core eldercare knowledge and has stayed on the home page in both years, which marks it as a strategically valued and well-absorbed offering.

The retail shop extends the firm's established sheltered workshop production know-how, and its promotion to the home page suggests positive early results, although retail lies somewhat further from the firm's care core.

Meal delivery for seniors fits the firm's eldercare client base and everyday-life assistance services, but it is new and only mentioned on the website, so there is little evidence yet and some risk that it will be discontinued.
